description: When a result says identity.recognised is weak, the person gave the email of a customer the business knows. Call this with item_id and access_token to email them six digits; ask the person for the code and call it again with code. Then the business recognises them.

access_token.description: Capability secret returned when the item was created without an account.

code.description: The six digits the customer received. Omit to have them sent.

name: verify_customer
title: Prove a known customer
